headline: Fiscal uncertainty prompts Brazilian asset managers to raise cash and dollar holdings
summary: Brazilian asset managers are reducing exposure to domestic equities and rate-cut bets, shifting portfolios toward cash reserves, US dollars, and defensive stocks due to fiscal policy uncertainties.
why: Capital allocation moves by local asset managers drive domestic stock market liquidity and currency exchange rate dynamics in Brazil.

impacts.name: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF
impacts.why: Funds cutting domestic equity exposure weighs on Brazilian equity benchmarks.
